full_prompt_en: A square architectural image shows a monumental concrete building beside a still pool under a pale blue-gray sky. The building occupies the center and most of the upper frame, while a broad paved platform stretches across its base and turns sharply around the dark water in the foreground. At the left, a low rounded volume sits behind a band of dark glazing. Above it, tall vertical slabs rise with softly curved upper corners, their surfaces divided by long formwork marks and faint weather stains. Near the center, a narrow rectangular bay projects forward, with a recessed dark window above an open, shadowed lower level. A heavier block pushes out toward the upper right, its underside visible as a broad dark plane and its end punctuated by closely spaced window divisions. More concrete arms extend to the right at staggered heights, producing a rhythm of solid horizontal ledges and deep gaps. The supporting piers are thick and plain; the openings beneath the cantilevers appear dark brown and charcoal against the chalky gray walls. Fine seams, vertical streaks, and slight discoloration give the concrete a weathered rather than polished surface. The viewpoint is low enough to emphasize the mass of the overhangs, yet the entire structure remains readable against the empty sky. Across the lower edge, the pool catches a restrained, blurred reflection of the building and the sky. Overcast daylight spreads evenly from above, leaving the exposed faces pale and the recesses in cool, heavy shade without a sharp cast shadow. The overall composition balances severe geometric mass against open sky and quiet water, making the alternating projections and voids the main visual event.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形建筑画面呈现一座矗立在静水池畔的巨型混凝土建筑，背景是浅蓝灰色天空。建筑占据中央及画面上方的大部分区域，宽阔的铺地平台横贯其底部，在前景深色池水边急转。左侧一处低矮的圆角体块位于一条深色玻璃带后方。其上方高耸的竖向板片带有略圆的顶角，表面有纵长的模板痕迹和浅淡的风化污迹。靠近中央，一个窄矩形空间向前突出，上部是后退的深色窗，下部是敞开而阴暗的空间。更厚重的体块向右上方外挑，宽阔而深暗的底面清晰可见，末端有间距紧密的窗格。更多混凝土横臂以错落高度伸向右方，形成坚实水平边缘与深凹空隙交替的节奏。支撑柱粗壮朴素，悬挑下的开口呈深棕和炭灰色，与粉白灰色的墙面相对。细接缝、竖向流痕和轻微变色使混凝土显得经受风雨，而不是抛光光滑。视点较低，突出悬挑的重量，同时整座建筑仍完整地显露在空旷天空前。画面下缘的水池模糊地映出建筑与天空，反射十分克制。阴天日光从上方均匀散开，使外露立面偏浅，凹陷处则沉在冷而厚重的阴影里，没有锐利投影。整体构图以严峻的几何体量对照开阔天空和安静水面，让外挑实体与空隙的交替成为主要视觉事件。
style_prompt_en: The image has a restrained photographic finish built from large raw-concrete volumes and strongly legible negative spaces. Straight slab edges meet occasional rounded ends, while broad horizontal projections cross taller vertical masses and make their undersides conspicuously dark. Pale chalk gray and blue-gray occupy most of the frame; charcoal recesses and a narrow range of muted brown stains supply the contrast. The concrete shows fine casting seams, vertical weather streaks, and uneven matte patches rather than decorative surface detail. Diffuse overcast light softens exposed planes, while deep openings hold dense cool shade. A low, steady viewpoint gives the forms a monumental weight, and broad quiet areas around them keep the geometry readable. The overall effect is austere, still, and sculptural, with mass and void organized in an irregular but balanced rhythm.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有克制的摄影质感，由大块裸露混凝土体量和清晰可辨的负空间构成。笔直板边偶有圆角，宽大的水平外挑横穿较高的竖向体块，使其深暗底面格外醒目。粉白灰和蓝灰占据画面大部分区域；炭灰色凹处与少量暗棕色污迹形成对比。混凝土表面有细模板接缝、纵向风化流痕和不均匀的哑光色斑，而没有装饰性的细节。阴天散射光柔化外露平面，深凹开口则保留浓重冷影。低而稳定的视点赋予形体纪念碑般的重量，周围宽阔安静的区域让几何关系容易辨认。整体效果严峻、静止而富雕塑性，实体与空隙以不规则却平衡的节奏组织。
theme_en: A pale concrete building of stacked projecting volumes beside a still pool
theme_zh: 静水池畔由层叠外挑体块组成的浅色混凝土建筑
name: Brutalism
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
